The protagonist is an ordinary, unremarkable middle-aged single salaryman. Despite his age, he has little experience with women, no prospects for marriage, and spends his empty days indulging in erotic fantasies.

One day, after winning big at pachinko and landing 1 million yen, he visits the cabaret club ‘Fantasy’—a place he could rarely afford—and meets three girls.
